summary: The reader has finished an undergraduate computer science degree: asymptotic analysis, algorithms (divide and conquer, recurrences, FFT-style ideas at a basic level), discrete mathematics (sets, binomial coefficients, binary representation, modular arithmetic, primes), and linear algebra (vector spaces, subspaces, rank, matrix products, Gaussian elimination, orthogonal projections, over the rationals and basic finite fields). They know complex numbers and polynomials, and basic Turing machines. They have not studied advanced algebra (Bruhat decomposition, general rings and quotients in depth), number theory beyond basics, numerical error analysis of FFTs, or the research literature on fast multiplication.

known.name: Binary representation of integers
known.gloss: Writing a nonnegative integer as a sum of bits times powers of two, and reading integers as bit strings.

known.name: Hamming weight
known.gloss: The number of 1 bits in the binary representation of an integer or bit string.

known.name: Bitwise XOR
known.gloss: The bitwise operation that adds bits modulo 2.

known.name: Modular arithmetic
known.gloss: Arithmetic on integers with results reduced modulo a fixed modulus.

known.name: Prime numbers and coprimality
known.gloss: Integers with no nontrivial divisors, and integers sharing no common factor.

known.name: Linear algebra over the rationals
known.gloss: Vector spaces, subspaces, dimension, matrix rank, matrix products and orthogonal projections over the rational numbers.

known.name: Gaussian elimination and the general linear group over F2
known.gloss: Reducing a matrix by row operations, and the fact that invertible matrices over the two-element field are products of elementary row operations.

known.name: Binomial coefficients and basic counting
known.gloss: Counting subsets of a given size and basic counting arguments.

known.name: Recurrences and divide and conquer
known.gloss: Bounding the cost of recursive algorithms by solving recurrences over subproblems.

known.name: Exponentials, logarithms and iterated logarithm bounds
known.gloss: Standard manipulation of exponentials and logarithms and comparing growth such as (lg n)^c versus n^epsilon.

known.name: Matrix and block notation
known.gloss: Writing linear maps as matrices, block and diagonal forms, and products of matrices acting on separate coordinates.

known.name: Roots of unity and Euler's formula
known.gloss: The complex numbers whose powers return to 1, written as exponentials of imaginary angles.

known.name: Fast Fourier transform idea
known.gloss: The basic recursive O(N log N) evaluation of a length-N transform at roots of unity.

known.name: Sorting and permutations
known.gloss: Rearranging a list of items by a permutation of positions, and the O(N log N) cost of sorting.

known.name: Basic real error bounds
known.gloss: Rounding to nearest integers, bounding errors by sums and the triangle inequality, and binary fixed-point numbers.

known.name: Schoolbook integer multiplication and carries
known.gloss: Multiplying integers digit by digit in a given radix with carries, taking quadratic time.
